scope.methodology: Limited-S-M0 / all-W-Engine aggregate fields; Standard S/A mindscapes and potential are uncontrolled. With total composition uses > 10, trim_mean(0.25) is used when abs(skewness) > 0.8, else the arithmetic mean. These seven single-partition JSON exports require total uses >= 2 and suppress scores >= 35000 when total uses <= 10. The exact M0 mean sample size and per-team variance are unpublished.

observationPopulation.aggregation: When total composition uses > 10 and abs(skewness) > 0.8: scipy trim_mean(0.25); otherwise arithmetic mean. Single-partition JSON requires total uses >= 2; scores >= 35000 with total uses <= 10 are suppressed.
